title: Project Coordinator
apply_instructions: SEEK links out to Queensland Government SmartJobs (Job Ad Reference QLD/703863/26). Closes Monday 26 October 2026. Read the role description attachment on SmartJobs and follow its how-to-apply instructions.
rationale: RoadTek (TMR) Project Coordinator in Winton: plan and coordinate multi-functional crews on civil road infrastructure, coordinate subcontractors and suppliers, short-term programming, risk and quality, assist tendering and estimating.

Matches Marc's 2019 project-in-charge work coordinating 10 to 15 workers a day and tracking progress, his field engineer work on procurement, material records and progress reports, and coursework cost estimates and bills of quantities.
Only mandatory item is a current Queensland C class licence or equivalent and ability to travel; Marc holds an Australian driver's licence and is available for regional and Central Queensland travel.
caution: OO6 level role at $94,704 to $99,582 that also mentors project staff; Marc's coordination experience is about a year in the Philippines, not Australian road crews. Winton is remote Central West Queensland: relocation is open to discuss only, Marc to confirm. Cert IV Project Management and Frontline Management are desirable and not held.
gaps: Coordination experience is from the Philippines 2019 to 2020, not Australian road works
